'''Transport droids''' were created on [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]] during the [[Mechis III Uprising]].
[[IG-88C/Legends|IG-88C]] personally oversaw the shipping of one thousand transport droids to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that all had [[sentience programming]] modification.
